lastResponse.text: Yeah, two low-pressure options right now: Rose Haven Day Center in Portland, at 1740 Northwest Glisan Street. You can call 503…248…6364. They’re drop-in and no documents required, but they serve women, trans, nonbinary, and gender-expansive adults and minor kids. If that’s not a fit, we can ask a live two one one specialist for a youth-specific Clackamas day spot near bus lines and private support. You can keep it simple: “I need a youth day center I can reach by bus, with phone charging and private talk space.”
